happeningTypes.name: Conduct a specified behavioral test of an uncertainty prediction
happeningTypes.description: Under a qualified protocol, state an uncertainty-related prediction and compare it with the observed outcome of a specified consensual behavioral test. This operation is not the entire twelve-session therapy course and promises no efficacy.
happeningTypes.constraints: Independently assessed clinical suitability, consent, safety, uncertainty limits, legal/ethical review and professional competence. No treatment advice, automatic permission, package-effect inference or recommendation.

happeningTypes.name: Instruct specified outgoing behavior for a bounded interval
happeningTypes.description: Ask a consenting participant to enact specified bold/talkative/assertive social behaviors for a declared interval. Not group assignment, friendship creation, digital coaching package or promise of trait change.
happeningTypes.constraints: Voluntary participation and safe social setting; respect fatigue, authenticity, introvert costs, privacy and other persons' consent; context/legal/ethical feasibility required. No practitioner/model eligibility.

assertions.scope: Isolated or repeated specified behavioral uncertainty tests, not automatically the entire therapeutic course.
assertions.measurement: Enduring intolerance of uncertainty, not primary GAD severity, worry or successful test completion.
assertions.timing: Twelve-week course evidence and6/12month uncontrolled-after-crossover follow-up cannot isolate one operation's durable effect.
assertions.mechanism: Repeated experiences may alter appraisals and behavioral patterns; exact independent enduring construct change is not established by current scoped evidence.
assertions.risk: Component/package, time-scale, within/between-person, self-report and multidimensional-scope mismatch; no automatic therapeutic/practitioner permission.
assertions.rationale: Preserve supporting package findings and observed heterogeneity/nulls while refusing isolated-operation or whole-trait causal transfer. Requires exact comparator, measure, follow-up and feature scope.

assertions.scope: Specified outgoing-behavior instructions versus contemporaneous sham over one week; do not combine with PEACH package as same operation.
assertions.measurement: Enduring sociability/assertiveness/energy facets, not one-week behavior, positive affect or authenticity.
assertions.timing: One-week instruction versus months-years trait; three-month coaching/follow-up evidence is a different package.
assertions.mechanism: Repeated experiences may alter appraisals and behavioral patterns; exact independent enduring construct change is not established by current scoped evidence.
assertions.risk: Component/package, time-scale, within/between-person, self-report and multidimensional-scope mismatch; no automatic therapeutic/practitioner permission.
assertions.rationale: Preserve supporting package findings and observed heterogeneity/nulls while refusing isolated-operation or whole-trait causal transfer. Requires exact comparator, measure, follow-up and feature scope.

findings.population: Adults with GAD, majority women, mean34.6(range19–67)
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.measurement: Secondary intolerance-of-uncertainty measure; primaryGAD severity separately
findings.result: Course group improved more on all reported outcomes including IU. This supports the course contrast, not a single component.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE isolated-operation efficacy: repeated course/therapist context bundled; abstract does not extract exact item/longitudinal invariance or active placebo.

findings.design: Combined treated sample follow-up after waitlist crossover
findings.population: Adults with GAD, majority women, mean34.6(range19–67)
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.comparator: Own earlier assessment; no continued untreated control
findings.result: Reported gains maintained/increased; enduring follow-up is encouraging but not a randomized follow-up contrast.
findings.limitations: Same dataset, no independent replication; regression/history/retention limitations; no causal IU-mediated anxiety inference.

findings.design: Systematic review, trials and prepost designs
findings.population: Source-specific volunteers/patients; population transfer not assumed
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.result: Trait-score change reported in both design classes; therapy type not strongly related to amount of change.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE exact uncertainty-test identity and exact IU construct; studies/designs not interchangeable or independent of included literature.

findings.design: Randomized one-week intervention versus sham; additional historical group
findings.population: Source-specific volunteers/patients; population transfer not assumed
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.comparator: Contemporaneous sham; historical contactcontrol not randomized
findings.result: Overall positive affect/authenticity benefits but more introverted participants reported less positive benefit and greater negative affect/tiredness/lower authenticity.
findings.limitations: No enduring Extraversion outcome proven; facet/trait moderation not standalone governed edge; historical control not concurrent randomized evidence.

findings.design: Randomized one-month waitlist then coaching crossover
findings.population: Self-selected German-reading nonclinical smartphone users motivated to change personality
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.result: Self changes aligned with goals; observer increases clearer than decreases; no continued untreated comparator at final follow-up.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE outgoing-instruction identity: coaching bundles psychoeducation, diary, reminders and other tools. Attrition, selected goals and unblinded reports; no package/component transfer.

findings.design: Measurement-invariance reanalysis of selected PEACH participants
findings.population: Self-selected German-reading nonclinical smartphone users motivated to change personality
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.comparator: Time and different changegoal groups, not fresh randomization
findings.result: Extraversion self change concentrated in sociability, not allfacets; conscientiousness organization/productiveness notuniformresponsibility. Scalar invariance concerns.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE instruction-alone evidence; same PEACH dataset, selected subset, no independent replication or whole-profile sign.

findings.population: Self-selected German-reading nonclinical smartphone users motivated to change personality
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.result: Observers generally showed small nonsignificant changes; not equivalence or proof of zero.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE instruction-alone null; same study contribution as preceding facet finding. Missingness and precision not extracted for equivalence.

findings.population: Source-specific volunteers/patients; population transfer not assumed
findings.context: Specified clinical/digital/social task; no uncontrolled occurrence ingestion
findings.result: Completion predicted growth; mere acceptance did not. Selection and actual behavior differ.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE outgoing-instruction controlled effect: completion not randomized; compliance, motivation and shared method; not proof that completing a given challenge causes trait growth.
